correctness.rationale: Exact positive Dirichlet second-moment matrix inverse gives the projector kernel. The integrated absolute kernel norm is strictly below the largest vertex integral for nonvertex evaluations because vertex kernels disagree in sign on a positive-measure open set. Marginal beta truncation computes each vertex norm. Splitting a three-coordinate Dirichlet law and strict conditional Jensen at the sign-change kink proves strictly decreasing L_T(a) at fixed T. Equality and positivity defect follow from sharp L∞ integration. Gamma scaling follows from uniform second moments. The attached checker reproduces 373 exact and 28 numerical checks but the proof is analytic.

value.rationale: Continuous, unequal-weight Dirichlet simplex laws form the natural full multivariate Jacobi weight family. For all dimensions and concentrations the result collapses a many-parameter sharp stability problem to the single least concentration, gives a strict geometric localization of every norming evaluation and input, controls negative affine least-squares overshoot, and computes an explicit gamma-law large-parameter limit. The unweighted constant is prior; this all-asymmetric structural classification is not just a trivial numerical instance.
